# dodopayments_credit_entitlement (Resource)

Manages a credit entitlement.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "dodopayments_credit_entitlement" "example" {
  currency         = "USD"
  name             = "example-credit-entitlement"
  overage_enabled  = false
  precision        = 2
  price_per_unit   = "10.5"
  rollover_enabled = false
  unit             = "credits"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the credit entitlement.
- `overage_enabled` (Boolean) Whether overage charges are enabled when credits run out.
- `precision` (Number) Precision for credit amounts (0-10 decimal places). A change to this value destroys the resource and creates a new resource.
- `rollover_enabled` (Boolean) Whether rollover is enabled for unused credits.
- `unit` (String) Unit of measurement for the credit (e.g., "API Calls", "Tokens", "Credits").

### Optional

- `currency` (String) Currency for pricing (required if price_per_unit is set).
- `description` (String) Optional description of the credit entitlement.
- `expires_after_days` (Number) Number of days after which credits expire (optional).
- `max_rollover_count` (Number) Maximum number of times credits can be rolled over.
- `overage_behavior` (String) Controls how overage is handled at billing cycle end.
Defaults to forgive_at_reset if not specified. If you remove this attribute from the configuration, the API keeps the last value.
- `overage_limit` (Number) Maximum overage units allowed (optional).
- `price_per_unit` (String) Price per credit unit.
- `rollover_percentage` (Number) Percentage of unused credits that can rollover (0-100).
- `rollover_timeframe_count` (Number) Count of timeframe periods for rollover limit.
- `rollover_timeframe_interval` (String) Interval type for rollover timeframe.

### Read-Only

- `business_id` (String)
- `created_at` (String)
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `updated_at` (String)

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `identity` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = dodopayments_credit_entitlement.example
  identity = {
    id = "<id>"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
### Identity Schema

#### Required

- `id` (String) The ID of the credit entitlement.

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = dodopayments_credit_entitlement.example
  id = "<id>"
}
```

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import a credit entitlement by its ID.
terraform import dodopayments_credit_entitlement.example <id>
```
